Для измерения температуры в современных: Modern multimeters use a thermocouple to measure temperature. The thermocouple is very simple: three wire segments are soldered in series, with the outer wires made of one material and the middle wire made of another. If the solder joints are kept at different temperatures, a constant voltage{0} proportional to the temperature difference between the joints appears at the thermocouple ends. In the provided equipment, one of the solder joints is inside the device.
